purpose: Afar Messages card fallback for https://burnbar.ai/c/v1#<fields>. The page is imported byte for byte; only scripts/lib/card-host.mjs and firebase.json describe how BurnBar serves it.

source.commitSubject: Harden the card fallback page for hosting; name it Afar

notImported.docs/imessage-card-web/.well-known/apple: Universal links stay off. An association file needs the approved team ID and proven entitlement and profile eligibility, and firebase.json's '**/.*' ignore and default appAssociation (AUTO) must be resolved first.
